I will create an attractive English listing, use relevant job boards, Chinese professional networks, WeChat groups, industry referrals, and electronics contacts, then screen résumés, conduct first-round interviews, and verify references. I work in electronics sourcing from China — finding manufacturers, buying components, and following orders through to shipment. On boards specifically: single and double-sided, multilayer and higher-density work, and full turnkey assembly — bare PCB from one shop, components from authorised distributors, SMT and test at another, then packaging and export paperwork. I don't design boards; I make sure the board you specified is built correctly, on time, at the price quoted.

In practice that means:

Shortlisting factories in Shenzhen, Dongguan, Suzhou and Kunshan on capability, process limits, MOQ and lead time — not price alone.

Verifying components before anything is committed: authorised channel or broker, date codes, distributor invoices.

Attending first article and pilot builds, checking workmanship against IPC-A-610, and chasing non-conformities until they close.

Coordinating test, packaging and export documents, with photo or video evidence at each handover.

Working in English and Mandarin throughout, so the spec doesn't drift between you and the factory.

Send me your board types and volumes, and I'll come back with a factory shortlist and indicative pricing as a first step.
